name: MobileRadio TwinBench
description: MobileRadio TwinBench v0.2.1 is a measurement-calibrated synthetic dataset for evaluating mobile-radio reconstruction and degradation detection under incomplete telemetry. Calibration uses the public multi-device and multi-operator Android mobile-network coverage dataset, version 2 (https://doi.org/10.17632/tjg9426ykr.2). The synthetic release contains 600 base trajectories expanded into 2,400 scenarios covering four balanced conditions: normal radio with complete telemetry, normal radio with incomplete telemetry, degraded radio with complete telemetry, and degraded radio with incomplete telemetry. It includes 350,296 latent trajectory rows, 703,475 observation-report rows and 600 controlled degradation-event records. Observation records contain 2,883 additional duplicate reports and 11,815 reports labelled as delayed. Radio variables include RSRP, RSRQ, SNR, CQI and RSSI for 4G and 5G NSA network states. Generation combines profile-conditioned empirical distributions, Gaussian-copula dependence, autoregressive temporal dependence, estimated technology transitions and handover rates, and synthetic local movement. Paired scenarios retain links to the same underlying trajectories, allowing comparisons against known latent truth. Incomplete telemetry introduces random and burst missingness, reporting delays and duplicate observations.
